components.name: Powerhouse Assurance Layer
components.authority: GitHub current main plus GitHub Actions readback
components.data_contract: Consumes assurance manifests and existing evidence references; creates no parallel business-data authority.
components.security_contract: Read-only validation; no secret values in manifests; fail-closed on contract gaps.
components.observability_contract: GitHub Actions check plus deterministic JSON report.

recovery_contract.evidence: CI rerun and Git revert are intrinsic to this non-runtime validation layer

components.cost_capacity_contract: Static deterministic validation; bounded repository scan; no paid provider calls.
components.evidence_contract: Merged SHA, successful Powerhouse Assurance workflow, current-main readback and Notion writeback.
components.learning_contract: Failures become deduplicated obligations and feed existing Powerhouse learning/error lineage.

components.name: Powerhouse Quality Intelligence
components.authority: Powerhouse Assurance + BRAIN-DELIVERY-v2 + deterministic GitHub Actions evidence; v2 is an extension and v1 remains release authority
components.data_contract: Creates quality evidence, blind-spot obligations and impact classification only; business/runtime truth remains in existing canonical Powerhouse and provider authorities.
components.security_contract: AI cannot waive deterministic gates; security findings remain independent; destructive production exploration is forbidden; no secrets are inferred or persisted; unregistered authenticated targets remain fail-closed obligations.
components.observability_contract: Per-dimension GitHub Actions evidence with exact candidate SHA, artifacts and deterministic status; scheduled deep sensors preserve their own evidence; UNKNOWN/NOT_REGISTERED are never green.

recovery_contract.evidence: v1+v2 core quality contracts are regression-tested and revertable; external deep targets remain independently evidenced and must not be inferred from core green.

components.cost_capacity_contract: Impact-select expensive PR jobs; deep browser/adversarial/performance/mutation/DAST/provenance jobs are scheduled/manual; quality economics may place tests but cannot waive critical gates.
components.evidence_contract: Core green requires deterministic v1+v2 contract evidence on exact candidate SHA. Scheduled sensors, exact-SHA provenance and registered external targets require their own same-target evidence and may never be inferred from a skipped/unregistered test.
components.learning_contract: Escaped defects reuse BRAIN-CLOSED-LOOP-v1 and BG168/BG166/BG167; no parallel QA learning store. Internet discoveries are candidates for controlled experiments, never automatic adoption.

components.name: Public website and Netlify delivery surface
components.authority: GitHub current main + Netlify production deploy + public URL readback
components.data_contract: Website reads/writes only through approved canonical Powerhouse and provider contracts.
components.security_contract: Headers, redirects, server-side secret boundaries and public-route fail-closed rules remain code/release governed.
components.observability_contract: Netlify deploy SHA, public URL readback and existing health/analytics evidence.

recovery_contract.evidence: Git revert and Netlify deploy rollback path; destructive production drill not yet evidenced

components.cost_capacity_contract: Netlify/Supabase/provider usage is covered by existing Powerhouse resource-footprint monitoring.
components.evidence_contract: Current-main SHA must match deployment/readback; browser/provider proof remains external evidence.
components.learning_contract: Deployment and production failures write back to existing Powerhouse error/learning lineage.

components.name: Portal V2 canonical customer surface
components.authority: GitHub current main + Netlify production readback + Supabase/Powerhouse data authority
components.data_contract: Portal is a dynamic view on canonical Powerhouse data; user input writes back to the same lineage.
components.security_contract: Authenticated customer context, tenant isolation, identity and permission gates fail closed.
components.observability_contract: Portal parity tests, production URL readback and runtime-event evidence.

recovery_contract.evidence: Rollback path documented; parity test is explicitly not treated as a recovery drill

components.cost_capacity_contract: Uses existing Netlify/Supabase capacity and Powerhouse resource-footprint metering.
components.evidence_contract: Code parity is separate from production interaction proof; both must be visible in assurance status.
components.learning_contract: Portal errors, overrides and customer interactions feed existing Powerhouse outcome/learning lineage.

components.name: GitHub workflow fleet
components.data_contract: Workflow state is release evidence; business runtime state remains in Powerhouse/providers.
components.security_contract: Least-privilege workflow permissions; secrets are referenced, never documented.
components.observability_contract: Workflow conclusions, job logs and check-run readback.

recovery_contract.evidence: GitHub rerun/revert via current-main release process

components.cost_capacity_contract: Bounded by GitHub Actions quotas and workflow timeouts.
components.evidence_contract: Successful check run at the exact merged SHA.
components.learning_contract: Failed checks create/update existing Powerhouse obligations; no silent bypass.

components.name: Netlify production function fleet
components.authority: GitHub current main + Netlify production deployment/readback
components.data_contract: Functions may read/write only through existing canonical Powerhouse contracts.
components.security_contract: Server-side secrets only; public routes fail closed for privileged actions.
components.observability_contract: Netlify deployment/function readback plus existing health contracts.

recovery_contract.evidence: Netlify deploy rollback + Git revert runbook

components.cost_capacity_contract: Covered by Powerhouse resource-footprint and provider quota monitoring.
test_contract: existing function-specific tests and production proof workflows
components.evidence_contract: Netlify deployed SHA and function-specific provider/HTTP readback.
components.learning_contract: Failures/outcomes feed existing Powerhouse error/learning lineage.

components.name: Supabase Edge Function fleet
components.authority: GitHub current main migrations/functions + Supabase production runtime
components.data_contract: Canonical tenant-aware Powerhouse schema, provenance and lineage contracts.
components.security_contract: RLS/service-role boundaries, authenticated privileged execution and explicit grants.
components.observability_contract: Function invocation/readback, database health and scheduled runtime evidence.

recovery_contract.evidence: Git migration/function rollback and Supabase recovery process

components.cost_capacity_contract: Covered by resource-footprint, token/provider and database capacity monitoring.
components.evidence_contract: Production schema/function readback and runtime event evidence.
components.learning_contract: Runtime failures/outcomes feed existing Powerhouse learning/calibration lineage.
